name: Banana Addons for Elementor
author: Farhadur Rahim

sections.description:
Banana Addons for Elementor extends the Elementor page builder adds 35+ widgets and 2+ features to Elementor, helping you build beautiful and functional WordPress websites.

Useful Links

Demo | Docs | Videos | Github | Support | IdeaSharing | FacebookGroup | Get Pro

Video Tutorial

Include soon!

Widgets In BananaAddons Free Version

  • Info Card: Create information boxes.
  • Progress Bars: Showcase progressive information.
  • Review: Add feedback, reviews, & ratings.
  • Embed Content: Add third-party content within site.
  • Simple Heading: Add Simple Heading for wordpress site.
  • Image Compare: Showcase before/after images.
  • Team Member: Showcase team members.
  • Dual Button: Add two buttons within one container.
  • Testimonial: Add testimonial sections.
  • Avatar Group: Show avatar as stack views.
  • Pricing Table: Build pricing table.
  • Flex Card: Create Flex Card items.
  • Post List: List any posts.
  • Hover Link: Add animated link hover effects.
  • PDF Viewer: PDF Viewer widget.
  • Call to Action: Call to Action widget.
  • Site Logo: Customize site’s logo.
  • Site Title: Design site’s title.

Widgets in BananaAddons Pro Version

  • Text Animation: Animated headings/texts with it.
  • Animated Heading: Show animated heading in site.
  • Flip Box: Create 3d-flipped items.
  • Logo Carousel: Add multiple logos as carousel.
  • Advanced Heading: Show advanced heading in site.
  • Advanced Google Map: Show advanced Google Map in site.
  • Image Masking: Show Image in beautiful shape Masking.
  • Business Hours: Display Business Hours in site.
  • Code Highlighter: Showcase code snippets beautifully.
  • Testimonial Carousel: Showcase testimonials in carousel.
  • Facebook Feed: Bring Facebook-feed within site.
  • Open Street Map: Embed Open Street Map within site.
  • PayPal Button: Add PayPal Button in site.
  • Smart PayPal Button: Add Smart PayPal Button in site.
  • Stripe Buy Button: Add Stripe Buy Button in site.
  • Post Title: Add and style post’s title.
  • Page Title: Stylize page titles.

Free Extensions of BananaAddons:

  • Wrapper Link: Hyperlinked to any section/container.
  • Equal Height: It offers equal heights to all column in a section.
  • Banana Clone: It offers duplicate an existing page.

Missing-Anything?

If you miss anything Submit ideas.

We truly appreciate your support. If our work brought a smile, please spread the joy by giving us a 5***** rating would mean a lot to us.

sections.installation:
Step 1: Upload the plugin file to install by navigating through Plugins➔Add New➔Upload Plugin➔Choose File to Install from your WordPress dashboard or you can simply search for the Banana Addons plugin from the plugin directory by going to Plugins➔Add New and search for the plugin in the search tab to install it on your WordPress site.

Step 2: After successful installation, you have to click the “activate” button to activate the Banana Addons for Elementor.

Step 3: When you activate Banana Addons for Elementor you will be redirected to our BananaAddons Dashboard Home Tab.

For a more detailed explanation check out the following documentation

☞ How to Install Banana Addons For Elementor
sections.faq:
Can I use Banana Addons without Elementor?

No, Banana Addons requires Elementor to work. You can’t use it without Elementor.

Does it work along with other Elementor Addons?

Yes. It includes additional features like Wrapper Link for other addons or extensions.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes. It works with any WordPress theme that supports Elementor, and it performs best with the Hello Elementor theme.

Does it work with Elementor Pro?

Yes, without a doubt.

Will Banana Addons break my site after an update?

No, updating will not break your site or pages using our plugin. We ensure maximum stability, but we recommend taking a backup before updating. If any issue occurs, simply restore your backup and contact our support team.
